placement.claim: A UI experience-evidence façade over generic evidence lineage, Chrome Vision, product adapters, and review consumers is the probable semantic boundary; permanent package, service, storage, query, and capture ownership remain unresolved pending real dogfood.

reopening_conditions: A real view cannot retain stable semantic identity separately from the navigation or fixture mechanism used to reach it.
Structural, pixel, temporal, interaction, and accessibility evidence require incompatible freshness or authority semantics that make one experience-evidence façade misleading.
The claim-centered lineage candidate cannot represent observation applicability and exact reviewer reliance without erasing the distinction between captured facts and semantic claims.
Four dimension-specific review consumers do not materially reuse evidence or require incompatible state projections that defeat the proposed sharing boundary.
Cached provider analysis cannot preserve enough source, contract, model, limitation, and usage provenance to be safely reused without repeating the call.
Selective impact nomination proves either too coarse to save meaningful work or too incomplete to support truthful freshness judgments.
A real accessibility probe shows that product-specific applicability and governing criteria cannot remain separate from generic probe evidence.
A production consumer requires concurrency, delivery, authorization, privacy, retention, or recovery consequences intentionally deferred by the first dogfood.

authority.decision_owner: user or future explicitly authorized portfolio owner

relationships.rationale: The candidate requires equivalent stable identity, exact revision, provenance, impact nomination, refresh judgment, lineage, and exact-revision reliance semantics. Depending on those consequences does not accept the current shared-placement hypothesis.

Real UI observation and derived-analysis dogfood can reveal which lineage semantics are genuinely shared with claims and which require a distinct domain profile; its result cannot decide the parent candidate automatically.
If accepted, exact UI evidence and claim revisions can support revision-bound UI findings without review artifacts absorbing browser capture, provider analysis, or observation freshness.
An adaptive coordinator may select UI review perspectives that reuse this evidence, while selection, reviewer independence, synthesis, and downstream authority remain review-coordination concerns.
